raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The bar chart illustrates the perceived importance of various measures that could help businesses overcome the "hidden economy" in the country, based on survey responses. The horizontal axis represents the percentage of respondents, ranging from 0% to approximately 15%, with labeled intervals at 5% and 10%. The vertical axis lists different policy measures as categorical options, each associated with a horizontal bar indicating the percentage of support. The bars are color-coded: blue bars represent one category of responses, while red bars represent another, with the specific meaning of the colors not explicitly defined in the chart. The categories are listed in a descending order of the red bar values, starting with "Да се намали корупцията" (To reduce corruption) at 13%, followed by "Да се подобри качеството на административните..." (To improve the quality of administrative...) at 13%, and "Да се приемат по-строги закони" (To adopt stricter laws) at 13%. The blue bars show values such as 2% for "Да се засили граничния контрол" (To strengthen border control), 9% for "Да се засили данъчния контрол" (To strengthen tax control), and 5% for "Да се приемат по-строги закони" (To adopt stricter laws). The chart includes specific percentage values labeled at the end of each bar, providing precise data for each category.
